# Jacques Fourgeaud, PharmD, PhD

> Clinical virologist. Associate Professor of Clinical Virology (MCU-PH) at Université Paris Cité and Necker-Enfants Malades Hospital (AP-HP), Paris, France. Visiting Scholar at the University of California, San Francisco (2026-2027). Expertise: clinical metagenomics (unbiased sequencing for infection diagnosis), pathogen discovery, emerging and unusual viral infections, infections in immunocompromised patients, congenital cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection.

Key facts:
- Heads the clinical metagenomics program of Necker-Enfants Malades Hospital, Department of Bacteriology, Virology, Parasitology and Hospital Hygiene (ISO 15189 accredited, 2025).
- Deputy head of the laboratory associated with the French National Reference Center for congenital CMV infection.
- Training: PharmD (Université de Limoges), MSc in virology (Institut Pasteur), PhD in virology (Université Paris Cité, 2023).
- 59 peer-reviewed publications; ORCID 0000-0003-3631-184X.
- Languages: French (native), English.
